newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui Toatsu, Grand Polymer to combine PP business.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Toatsu, Grand Polymer to combine PP business.

text.p: Mitsui Toatsu Chemicals Inc said on Friday that its polypropylene (PP) production operation would be combined with that of Grand Polymer Co, which belongs to a firm with which it plans to merge next year.
A Mitsui Toatsu spokesman did not specify when the move would be made.

Grand Polymer, currently the second-largest polypropylene maker in Japan, was formed last year by Mitsui Petrochemical Industries Ltd and Ube Industries Ltd. Mitsui Toatsu and Mitsui Petrochemical will merge on October 1 next year.
The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Friday that Mitsui Toatsu would combine its polypropylene business with Grand Polymer's before its merger with Mitsui Petrochemical.
The move is expected to push up Grand Polymer's production capacity to just below that of industry leader Japan Polychem Corp, the paper said.
